_note: Level L->L+1 costs 'upgrade_cost' * (L), except Blacksmith which uses hardcoded costs in GameState.facility_upgrade_cost. Max level is capped at the Scroll cap; raising the cap from C to C+1 costs cap_scrolls[C-1] Scrolls of Upgrade (hard cap 'max'). Sum of cap_scrolls over all facilities = total Scroll supply (DECISIONS #150).

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
blacksmith.desc: L1 repair only. From Lv2: forge by gear tier (T5 at Lv5) and upgrade cap +1/+2/+3 at Lv2/3/4. Lv2→Lv3+ needs Dark Gold.

alchemy.name: Alchemy Pot
alchemy.desc: Brew potions. Lv2: Starter Elixirs. Potion belt 2/2/3/4/5 by level.

guild.name: Guild Hall
guild.desc: Supplies & Offline Patrols (2h/4h/8h/12h/16h by level). Rations and torches per expedition: 3/4/5/7/10 by level.

enchanter.name: Enchanter's Desk
enchanter.desc: Identify curios over time (faster and one more at a time per level; a known type is instant); scribe Scrolls of Passage. Levels rings and wands (cap +0/+1/+3/+4/+5 by Desk level) and repairs rings, wands and artifacts from Lv2.
